parameters: \n<Forest Keeper>Well well well, what do we have here... Let me look at that
scroll. Missing some roots ha?! Yes, I know where to find
them, of course I know where to find them.

parameters.name: You will need a boat - have key

parameters: \n<Forest Keeper>You will need a boat, you know. And it just so happens that
I have a boat... for you... as long as you give me the key to
\n<Forest Keeper>You may use my boat then, it will get you far far away.
Who knows how you'd ever get back home without that key...
\n<Forest Keeper>Go away then, get out of my forest before it's too late.

parameters.name: You will need a boat - no key

parameters: \n<Forest Keeper>You will need a boat, you know. It happens that I have a
boat... But I don't see anything you can give me in return.
So go away, I have had enough of this chit chat.
\n<Forest Keeper>Who dares come to me empty handed?!
Go home you kids, evil spirits are walking in the forest.
